name: Fact card
summary: Card with a DID YOU KNOW accent header pill, a bulb or info icon and a two to four line fact.

params.name: y
params.note: centre y; the card grows with the fact

params.name: header
params.note: text in the accent pill; keep it short

params.name: fact
params.default: Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.

params.name: color
params.note: header pill colour; default the style's accent

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

example.fact: Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.

author: krakujs
